title: How to Claim Your Cut of Apple’s $250 Million Siri Settlement
summary: Apple may pay out up to $95 for each eligible iPhone purchased by someone who felt misled about Siri’s release. You have until December 21 to submit a claim.
reason: Item is a consumer class-action settlement claims notice about Siri, not a model release, research result, AI business event (financing/M&A/partnership/market data/product launch), policy action, or OSS tool. No active rule covers legal settlement payouts to consumers.
